Opposite-side photograph50 and source camera were inspected; roll/lens/viewpoint remain unmatched. Do not call these fittings visually reviewed or silently remove antennas without resolving exact installation.
Original source camouflage chips and fin/rudder seam detail differ from the author photographs. Damage ownership is validated; exterior detail accuracy remains open.
